events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe headers and recent history
events.input: $ date && git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs && wc -l workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs && sed -n 1,40p workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs && grep -n "argv\|localhost\|127.0.0.1\|PORT" workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live public board probe

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the live public board probe from workshop-plan
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan && date +%T && (node probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t322-public.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> /tmp/t322-public.log); date +%T; grep -c "  ok  " /tmp/t322-public.log; grep -n "FAIL" /tmp/t322-public.log | head -20; tail -6 /tmp/t322-public.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the actions probe header and find the local board server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan && sed -n 1,30p probe-board-actions.mjs; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E "8899|88[0-9][0-9]|python|node" | head; ls tasks/*.py | head -20; git status --short tasks | head
